text: Confusion (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. Effect chance: 10%. The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

title: Psychic
text: Psychic (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

title: Hypnosis
text: Hypnosis (Psychic status move). Puts the target to sleep. The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

title: Meditate
text: Meditate (Psychic status move). Raises the user’s Attack by one stage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Agility
text: Agility (Psychic status move). Raises the user’s Speed by two stages. The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

title: Quick Attack
text: Quick Attack (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

title: Rage
text: Rage (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Teleport
text: Teleport (Psychic status move). Does nothing. Wild battles end immediately. The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

title: Night Shade
text: Night Shade (Ghost special move). Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

title: Mimic
text: Mimic (Normal status move). This move is replaced by the target’s last successfully used move, and its PP changes to 5. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if the user already knows the targeted move, this move will fail. This effect vanishes when the user leaves the field. If Chatter, Metronome, Mimic, Sketch, or Struggle is selected, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

title: Mimic
text: Mimic (Normal status move). The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.

title: Screech
text: Screech (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages. An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

title: Double Team
text: Double Team (Normal status move). Raises the user’s evasion by one stage. By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.

title: Recover
text: Recover (Normal status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.

title: Harden
text: Harden (Normal status move). Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.

title: Minimize
text: Minimize (Normal status move). Raises the user’s evasion by two stages. Stomp and Steamroller have double power against Pokémon that have used this move since entering the field. The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness.

title: Smokescreen
text: Smokescreen (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage. The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.

title: Confuse Ray
text: Confuse Ray (Ghost status move). Confuses the target. The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

title: Withdraw
text: Withdraw (Water status move). Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

title: Defense Curl
text: Defense Curl (Normal status move). Raises user’s Defense by one stage. After this move is used, the power of Ice Ball and Rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field. The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

title: Barrier
text: Barrier (Psychic status move). Raises the user’s Defense by two stages. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Light Screen
text: Light Screen (Psychic status move). Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from special attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier. If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns. Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier. A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

title: Haze
text: Haze (Ice status move). Removes stat, accuracy, and evasion modifiers from every Pokémon on the field. This does not count as a stat reduction for the purposes of Clear Body or White Smoke. The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

title: Reflect
text: Reflect (Psychic status move). Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier. If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns. Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier. A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

title: Focus Energy
text: Focus Energy (Normal status move). User’s critical hit rate is two levels higher until it leaves the field. If the user has already used Focus Energy since entering the field, this move will fail. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

title: Bide
text: Bide (Normal physical move). User waits for two turns. On the second turn, the user inflicts twice the damage it accumulated on the last Pokémon to hit it. Damage inflicted is typeless. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Metronome
text: Metronome (Normal status move). Selects any move at random and uses it. Moves the user already knows are not eligible. Assist, meta, protection, and reflection moves are also not eligible; specifically, Assist, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Quick Guard, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, and Wide Guard will not be selected by this move. This move cannot be

title: Metronome
text: Metronome (Normal status move). copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk. The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

title: Mirror Move
text: Mirror Move (Flying status move). Uses the last move targeted at the user by a Pokémon still on the field. A move counts as targeting the user even if it hit multiple Pokémon, as long as the user was one of them; however, moves targeting the field itself do not count. If the user has not been targeted by an appropriate move since entering the field, or if no Pokémon that targeted the user remains on the field, this move will fail. Moves that failed, missed, had no effect, or were blocked are still copied. Assist moves, time-delayed moves, “meta” moves that operate on other

title: Mirror Move
text: Mirror Move (Flying status move). moves/Pokémon/abilities, and some other special moves cannot be copied and are ignored; if the last move to hit the user was such a move, the previous move will be used instead. The full list of ignored moves is: Acid Armor, Acupressure, After You, Agility, Ally Switch, Amnesia, Aqua Ring, Aromatherapy, Aromatic Mist, Assist, Autotomize, Barrier, Baton Pass, Belch, Belly Drum, Bide, Bulk Up, Calm Mind, Camouflage, Celebrate, Charge, Coil, Conversion, Conversion 2, Copycat, Cosmic

title: Mirror Move
text: Mirror Move (Flying status move). Power, Cotton Guard, Counter, Crafty Shield, Curse, Defend Order, Defense Curl, Destiny Bond, Detect, Doom Desire, Double Team, Dragon Dance, Electric Terrain, Endure, Final Gambit, Flower Shield, Focus Energy, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Future Sight, Geomancy, Grassy Terrain, Gravity, Growth, Grudge, Guard Split, Hail, Happy Hour, Harden, Haze, Heal Bell, Heal Order, Heal Pulse, Healing Wish, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hone Claws, Howl, Imprison, Ingrain, Ion Deluge,

title: Mirror Move
text: Mirror Move (Flying status move). Iron Defense, King’s Shield, Light Screen, Lucky Chant, Lunar Dance, Magic Coat, Magnet Rise, Magnetic Flux, Mat Block, Me First, Meditate, Metronome, Milk Drink, Mimic, Minimize, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Mist, Misty Terrain, Moonlight, Morning Sun, Mud Sport, Nasty Plot, Nature Power, Perish Song, Power Split, Power Trick, Protect, Psych Up, Quick Guard, Quiver Dance, Rage Powder, Rain Dance, Recover, Recycle, Reflect, Reflect Type, Refresh, Rest, Rock Polish,

title: Mirror Move
text: Mirror Move (Flying status move). Role Play, Roost, Rototiller, Safeguard, Sandstorm, Shadow Blast, Shadow Bolt, Shadow Half, Shadow Rush, Shadow Shed, Shadow Sky, Shadow Storm, Shadow Wave, Sharpen, Shell Smash, Shift Gear, Sketch, Slack Off, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Soft-Boiled, Spikes, Spiky Shield, Spit Up, Splash, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Stockpile, Struggle, Substitute, Sunny Day, Swallow, Swords Dance, Synthesis, Tail Glow, Tailwind, Teleport, Toxic Spikes, Transform, Water Sport, Wide

title: Mirror Move
text: Mirror Move (Flying status move). Guard, Wish, Withdraw and Work Up. This move cannot be selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk, nor forced by Encore. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Self-Destruct
text: Self-Destruct (Normal physical move). User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

title: Egg Bomb
text: Egg Bomb (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Lick
text: Lick (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

title: Smog
text: Smog (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 40%. The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.

title: Sludge
text: Sludge (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

title: Bone Club
text: Bone Club (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 10%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Fire Blast
text: Fire Blast (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Effect chance: 10%. The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Waterfall
text: Waterfall (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 20%. The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

title: Clamp
text: Clamp (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Clamp
text: Clamp (Water physical move). This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Swift
text: Swift (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

title: Skull Bash
text: Skull Bash (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. User then charges for one turn before attacking. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. Effect chance: 100%. The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

title: Spike Cannon
text: Spike Cannon (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Constrict
text: Constrict (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Amnesia
text: Amnesia (Psychic status move). Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages. The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

title: Kinesis
text: Kinesis (Psychic status move). Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage. The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

title: Soft-Boiled
text: Soft-Boiled (Normal status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.

title: High Jump Kick
text: High Jump Kick (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

title: Glare
text: Glare (Normal status move). Paralyzes the target. The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

title: Dream Eater
text: Dream Eater (Psychic special move). Fails if not used on a sleeping Pokémon. Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user. The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

title: Poison Gas
text: Poison Gas (Poison status move). Poisons the target. A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

title: Barrage
text: Barrage (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Leech Life
text: Leech Life (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user. The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

title: Lovely Kiss
text: Lovely Kiss (Normal status move). Puts the target to sleep. With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

title: Sky Attack
text: Sky Attack (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. Critical hit chance is one level higher than normal. Has a chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. Effect chance: 30%. The user attacks the turn after using this move. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also make the target flinch.

title: Transform
text: Transform (Normal status move). User copies the target’s species, weight, type, ability, calculated stats (except HP), and moves. Copied moves will all have 5 PP remaining. IVs are copied for the purposes of Hidden Power, but stats are not recalculated. Choice Band, Choice Scarf, and Choice Specs stay in effect, and the user must select a new move. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor forced by Encore. The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.

title: Bubble
text: Bubble (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Dizzy Punch
text: Dizzy Punch (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. Effect chance: 20%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Spore
text: Spore (Grass status move). Puts the target to sleep. The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

title: Flash
text: Flash (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Psywave
text: Psywave (Psychic special move). Inflicts typeless damage between 50% and 150% of the user’s level, selected at random in increments of 10%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Splash
text: Splash (Normal status move). Does nothing. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

title: Acid Armor
text: Acid Armor (Poison status move). Raises the user’s Defense by two stages. The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

title: Crabhammer
text: Crabhammer (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Explosion
text: Explosion (Normal physical move). User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

title: Fury Swipes
text: Fury Swipes (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. The user attacks by raking the target with claws, scythes, or the like. This move hits two to five times in a row.

title: Bonemerang
text: Bonemerang (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn. The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

title: Rest
text: Rest (Psychic status move). User falls to sleep and immediately regains all its HP. If the user has another major status effect, sleep will replace it. The user will always wake up after two turns, or one turn with Early Bird. This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep. The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

title: Rock Slide
text: Rock Slide (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 30%. Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

title: Hyper Fang
text: Hyper Fang (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 10%. The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Sharpen
text: Sharpen (Normal status move). Raises the user’s Attack by one stage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Conversion
text: Conversion (Normal status move). User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves, selected at random. Hidden Power and Weather Ball are treated as Normal. Only moves with a different type are eligible, and Curse is never eligible. If the user has no suitable moves, this move will fail. The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

title: Tri Attack
text: Tri Attack (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target. One of these effects is selected at random; they do not each have independent chances to occur. Effect chance: 20%. The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

title: Super Fang
text: Super Fang (Normal physical move). Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP. The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

title: Slash
text: Slash (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Substitute
text: Substitute (Normal status move). Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the

title: Substitute
text: Substitute (Normal status move). doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche,

title: Substitute
text: Substitute (Normal status move). Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed,

title: Substitute
text: Substitute (Normal status move). and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as

title: Substitute
text: Substitute (Normal status move). by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal. The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

title: Struggle
text: Struggle (Normal physical move). Inflicts typeless regular damage. User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move is used automatically when a Pokémon cannot use any other move legally, e.g., due to having no PP remaining or being under the effect of both Encore and Torment at the same time. This move’s recoil is not treated as recoil for the purposes of anything that affects recoil, such as the ability Rock Head. It also is not prevented by Magic Guard. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected

title: Struggle
text: Struggle (Normal physical move). by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore. This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.

title: Sketch
text: Sketch (Normal status move). Permanently replaces itself with the target’s last used move. If that move is Chatter or Struggle, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore. This move enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

title: Triple Kick
text: Triple Kick (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses. Skill Link does not apply. A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

title: Thief
text: Thief (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

title: Spider Web
text: Spider Web (Bug status move). The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Mind Reader
text: Mind Reader (Normal status move). If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly. If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance

title: Mind Reader
text: Mind Reader (Normal status move). to break through the protection. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

title: Nightmare
text: Nightmare (Ghost status move). Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Gives the target a nightmare, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. If the target wakes up or leaves the field, this effect ends. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Flame Wheel
text: Flame Wheel (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw. Effect chance: 10%. The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Snore
text: Snore (Normal special move). Only usable if the user is sleeping. Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 30%. This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

title: Curse
text: Curse (Ghost status move). If the user is a Ghost: user pays half its max HP to place a curse on the target, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. Otherwise: Lowers the user’s Speed by one stage, and raises its Attack and Defense by one stage each. The curse effect is passed on by Baton Pass. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move. A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

title: Flail
text: Flail (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20 The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

title: Conversion 2
text: Conversion 2 (Normal status move). Changes the user’s type to a type either resistant or immune to the last damaging move that hit it. The new type is selected at random and cannot be a type the user already is. If there is no eligible new type, this move will fail. The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.

title: Aeroblast
text: Aeroblast (Flying special move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Cotton Spore
text: Cotton Spore (Grass status move). Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages. The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

title: Reversal
text: Reversal (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20 An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

title: Spite
text: Spite (Ghost status move). Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

title: Powder Snow
text: Powder Snow (Ice special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target. Effect chance: 10%. The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.

title: Protect
text: Protect (Normal status move). No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this

title: Protect
text: Protect (Normal status move). move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or

title: Protect
text: Protect (Normal status move). Metronome. This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

title: Mach Punch
text: Mach Punch (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

title: Scary Face
text: Scary Face (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages. The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

title: Feint Attack
text: Feint Attack (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Sweet Kiss
text: Sweet Kiss (Fairy status move). Confuses the target. The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

title: Belly Drum
text: Belly Drum (Normal status move). User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

title: Sludge Bomb
text: Sludge Bomb (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

title: Mud-Slap
text: Mud-Slap (Ground special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

title: Octazooka
text: Octazooka (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage. Effect chance: 50%. The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.

title: Spikes
text: Spikes (Ground status move). Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP. Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s

title: Spikes
text: Spikes (Ground status move). side of the field. The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

title: Zap Cannon
text: Zap Cannon (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

title: Foresight
text: Foresight (Normal status move). Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Destiny Bond
text: Destiny Bond (Ghost status move). If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

title: Perish Song
text: Perish Song (Normal status move). Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move. Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

title: Icy Wind
text: Icy Wind (Ice special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

title: Detect
text: Detect (Fighting status move). No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this

title: Detect
text: Detect (Fighting status move). move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or

title: Detect
text: Detect (Fighting status move). Metronome. This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

title: Bone Rush
text: Bone Rush (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.

title: Lock-On
text: Lock-On (Normal status move). If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly. If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)%

title: Lock-On
text: Lock-On (Normal status move). chance to break through the protection. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user's next move does not miss that target.

title: Outrage
text: Outrage (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move. The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

title: Sandstorm
text: Sandstorm (Rock status move). Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

title: Sandstorm
text: Sandstorm (Rock status move). A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

title: Giga Drain
text: Giga Drain (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user. A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

title: Endure
text: Endure (Normal status move). The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

title: Charm
text: Charm (Fairy status move). Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages. The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

title: Rollout
text: Rollout (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power. The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. This attack becomes more powerful each time it hits.

title: False Swipe
text: False Swipe (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1. A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

title: Swagger
text: Swagger (Normal status move). Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied. The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.

title: Milk Drink
text: Milk Drink (Normal status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.

title: Spark
text: Spark (Electric physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

title: Fury Cutter
text: Fury Cutter (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets. The user attacks by slashing the target with scythes, claws, or the like. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.

title: Steel Wing
text: Steel Wing (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.

title: Mean Look
text: Mean Look (Normal status move). The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass. The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

title: Attract
text: Attract (Normal status move). Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends. If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.

title: Sleep Talk
text: Sleep Talk (Normal status move). Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP. This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar. If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy

title: Sleep Talk
text: Sleep Talk (Normal status move). Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk. The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

title: Heal Bell
text: Heal Bell (Normal status move). Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party. The user makes a soothing bell chime to cure the status conditions of all its fellow party Pokémon and allies.

title: Return
text: Return (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Present
text: Present (Normal physical move). Randomly uses one of the following effects. Effect | Chance -------------------------------------------------- | -----: Inflicts regular damage with 40 power | 40% Inflicts regular damage with 80 power | 30% Inflicts regular damage with 120 power | 10% Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP | 20% On average, this

title: Present
text: Present (Normal physical move). move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP. The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. The gift restores HP sometimes, however.

title: Frustration
text: Frustration (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Safeguard
text: Safeguard (Normal status move). Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns. Does not cancel existing ailments. This effect remains even if the user leaves the field. If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect. This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash. The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

title: Pain Split
text: Pain Split (Normal status move). Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken. This effect fails against a Substitute. The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

title: Sacred Fire
text: Sacred Fire (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw. Effect chance: 50%. The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Magnitude
text: Magnitude (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71: Magnitude | Power | Chance --------: | ----: | -----: 4 | 10 | 5% 5 | 30 | 10% 6 | 50 | 20% 7 | 70 | 30% 8 | 90 | 20% 9 | 110 | 10% 10 | 150 | 5% This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to Dig.

title: Magnitude
text: Magnitude (Ground physical move). This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Dynamic Punch
text: Dynamic Punch (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

title: Megahorn
text: Megahorn (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

title: Dragon Breath
text: Dragon Breath (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

title: Baton Pass
text: Baton Pass (Normal status move). User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon. The following move effects are passed: * Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power

title: Baton Pass
text: Baton Pass (Normal status move). Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in. The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

title: Encore
text: Encore (Normal status move). The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if

title: Encore
text: Encore (Normal status move). the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail. The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

title: Pursuit
text: Pursuit (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power. This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Rapid Spin
text: Rapid Spin (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Rapid Spin
text: Rapid Spin (Normal physical move). The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

title: Sweet Scent
text: Sweet Scent (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.

title: Iron Tail
text: Iron Tail (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 30%. The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

title: Metal Claw
text: Metal Claw (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.

title: Vital Throw
text: Vital Throw (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

title: Morning Sun
text: Morning Sun (Normal status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP. The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

title: Synthesis
text: Synthesis (Grass status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP. The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

title: Moonlight
text: Moonlight (Fairy status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP. The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

title: Hidden Power
text: Hidden Power (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs. Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.) Power

title: Hidden Power
text: Hidden Power (Normal special move). is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5. Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table. Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass

title: Hidden Power
text: Hidden Power (Normal special move). 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Cross Chop
text: Cross Chop (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Twister
text: Twister (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make each target flinch. If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power. Effect chance: 20%. The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

title: Rain Dance
text: Rain Dance (Water status move). Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry

title: Rain Dance
text: Rain Dance (Water status move). Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

title: Sunny Day
text: Sunny Day (Fire status move). Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form;

title: Sunny Day
text: Sunny Day (Fire status move). every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn. The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

title: Crunch
text: Crunch (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 20%. The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

title: Mirror Coat
text: Mirror Coat (Psychic special move). Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome. A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.

title: Psych Up
text: Psych Up (Normal status move). Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move. The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

title: Extreme Speed
text: Extreme Speed (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

title: Ancient Power
text: Ancient Power (Rock special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.

title: Shadow Ball
text: Shadow Ball (Ghost special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 20%. The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

title: Future Sight
text: Future Sight (Psychic special move). Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will

title: Future Sight
text: Future Sight (Psychic special move). fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move. Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

title: Rock Smash
text: Rock Smash (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 50%. The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

title: Whirlpool
text: Whirlpool (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

title: Whirlpool
text: Whirlpool (Water special move). Effect chance: 100%. The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

title: Beat Up
text: Beat Up (Dark physical move). Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

title: Fake Out
text: Fake Out (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field. Effect chance: 100%. This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

title: Uproar
text: Uproar (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends. Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

title: Stockpile
text: Stockpile (Normal status move). Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied. If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not. The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.

title: Spit Up
