text: Bounce (Flying physical move). cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. Effect chance: 30%. The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

title: Mud Shot
text: Mud Shot (Ground special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

title: Poison Tail
text: Poison Tail (Poison physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 10%. The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.

title: Covet
text: Covet (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

title: Volt Tackle
text: Volt Tackle (Electric physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 10%. The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.

title: Magical Leaf
text: Magical Leaf (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

title: Water Sport
text: Water Sport (Water status move). Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Calm Mind
text: Calm Mind (Psychic status move). Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each. The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

title: Leaf Blade
text: Leaf Blade (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Dragon Dance
text: Dragon Dance (Dragon status move). Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each. The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

title: Rock Blast
text: Rock Blast (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

title: Shock Wave
text: Shock Wave (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

title: Water Pulse
text: Water Pulse (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. Effect chance: 20%. The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

title: Doom Desire
text: Doom Desire (Steel special move). Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will

title: Doom Desire
text: Doom Desire (Steel special move). fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move. Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.

title: Psycho Boost
text: Psycho Boost (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Roost
text: Roost (Flying status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn. The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

title: Gravity
text: Gravity (Psychic status move). For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop. Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes. Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect. *Bug*: If this move

title: Gravity
text: Gravity (Psychic status move). is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it. Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

title: Miracle Eye
text: Miracle Eye (Psychic status move). Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Wake-Up Slap
text: Wake-Up Slap (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Hammer Arm
text: Hammer Arm (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

title: Gyro Ball
text: Gyro Ball (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150. The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

title: Healing Wish
text: Healing Wish (Psychic status move). User faints. Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead. The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.

title: Brine
text: Brine (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power. This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.

title: Natural Gift
text: Natural Gift (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry. The berry is consumed. If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Feint
text: Feint (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

title: Pluck
text: Pluck (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen. The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

title: Tailwind
text: Tailwind (Flying status move). For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field. The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

title: Acupressure
text: Acupressure (Normal status move). Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages. The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages. If no stat is eligible, this move will fail. If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move. The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

title: Metal Burst
text: Metal Burst (Steel physical move). Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn. Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

title: U-turn
text: U-turn (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

title: U-turn
text: U-turn (Bug physical move). After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

title: Close Combat
text: Close Combat (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Effect chance: 100%. The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

title: Payback
text: Payback (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power. The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

title: Assurance
text: Assurance (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power. This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

title: Embargo
text: Embargo (Dark status move). Target cannot use its held item for five turns. If the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail. This effect is passed by Baton Pass. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Fling
text: Fling (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail. This move ignores Sticky Hold. If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail. The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

title: Psycho Shift
text: Psycho Shift (Psychic status move). If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target. Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.

title: Trump Card
text: Trump Card (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. PP remaining | Power ------------ | ----: 4 or more | 40 3 | 50 2 | 60 1 | 80 0 | 200 If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

title: Trump Card
text: Trump Card (Normal special move). This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Heal Block
text: Heal Block (Psychic status move). For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled. Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Wring Out
text: Wring Out (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Power Trick
text: Power Trick (Psychic status move). The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.

title: Gastro Acid
text: Gastro Acid (Poison status move). The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.

title: Lucky Chant
text: Lucky Chant (Normal status move). For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Me First
text: Me First (Normal status move). If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power. If the target moves before the user, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Copycat
text: Copycat (Normal status move). Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user. This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk. The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

title: Power Swap
text: Power Swap (Psychic status move). User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target. The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

title: Guard Swap
text: Guard Swap (Psychic status move). User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target. The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

title: Punishment
text: Punishment (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Last Resort
text: Last Resort (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail. This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

title: Worry Seed
text: Worry Seed (Grass status move). Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia. If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail. A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

title: Sucker Punch
text: Sucker Punch (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. This move is not affected by Iron Fist. This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

title: Toxic Spikes
text: Toxic Spikes (Poison status move). Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity. If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed. Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the

title: Toxic Spikes
text: Toxic Spikes (Poison status move). field. This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar. Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect. The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

title: Heart Swap
text: Heart Swap (Psychic status move). User swaps its stat modifiers with the target. The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

title: Aqua Ring
text: Aqua Ring (Water status move). Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

title: Magnet Rise
text: Magnet Rise (Electric status move). For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves. If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail. This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

title: Flare Blitz
text: Flare Blitz (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw. Effect chance: 10%. The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.

title: Force Palm
text: Force Palm (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 30%. The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

title: Aura Sphere
text: Aura Sphere (Fighting special move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

title: Rock Polish
text: Rock Polish (Rock status move). Raises the user’s Speed by two stages. The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.

title: Poison Jab
text: Poison Jab (Poison physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 30%. The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

title: Dark Pulse
text: Dark Pulse (Dark special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 20%. The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Night Slash
text: Night Slash (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Aqua Tail
text: Aqua Tail (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

title: Seed Bomb
text: Seed Bomb (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

title: Air Slash
text: Air Slash (Flying special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 30%. The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

title: X-Scissor
text: X-Scissor (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

title: Bug Buzz
text: Bug Buzz (Bug special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Dragon Pulse
text: Dragon Pulse (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

title: Dragon Rush
text: Dragon Rush (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 20%. The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Power Gem
text: Power Gem (Rock special move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

title: Drain Punch
text: Drain Punch (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user. The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

title: Vacuum Wave
text: Vacuum Wave (Fighting special move). Inflicts regular damage. The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

title: Focus Blast
text: Focus Blast (Fighting special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Energy Ball
text: Energy Ball (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Brave Bird
text: Brave Bird (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

title: Earth Power
text: Earth Power (Ground special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Switcheroo
text: Switcheroo (Dark status move). User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon

title: Switcheroo
text: Switcheroo (Dark status move). gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

title: Giga Impact
text: Giga Impact (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn. The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

title: Nasty Plot
text: Nasty Plot (Dark status move). Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages. The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Bullet Punch
text: Bullet Punch (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

title: Avalanche
text: Avalanche (Ice physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user. This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

title: Ice Shard
text: Ice Shard (Ice physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

title: Shadow Claw
text: Shadow Claw (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Thunder Fang
text: Thunder Fang (Electric physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 10%. The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

title: Ice Fang
text: Ice Fang (Ice physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 10%. The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

title: Fire Fang
text: Fire Fang (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 10%. The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

title: Shadow Sneak
text: Shadow Sneak (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

title: Mud Bomb
text: Mud Bomb (Ground special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage. Effect chance: 30%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Psycho Cut
text: Psycho Cut (Psychic physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Zen Headbutt
text: Zen Headbutt (Psychic physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 20%. The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Mirror Shot
text: Mirror Shot (Steel special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage. Effect chance: 30%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Flash Cannon
text: Flash Cannon (Steel special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 10%. The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Rock Climb
text: Rock Climb (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. Effect chance: 20%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Defog
text: Defog (Flying status move). Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Clears away fog. Removes the effects of Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the target’s side of the field. If the target is protected by Mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move. A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.

title: Trick Room
text: Trick Room (Psychic status move). For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect. Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect. The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

title: Draco Meteor
text: Draco Meteor (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages. Effect chance: 100%. Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

title: Discharge
text: Discharge (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

title: Lava Plume
text: Lava Plume (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.

title: Leaf Storm
text: Leaf Storm (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages. Effect chance: 100%. The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Power Whip
text: Power Whip (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

title: Rock Wrecker
text: Rock Wrecker (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn. The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.

title: Cross Poison
text: Cross Poison (Poison physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 10%. A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Gunk Shot
text: Gunk Shot (Poison physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

title: Iron Head
text: Iron Head (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 30%. The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Magnet Bomb
text: Magnet Bomb (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Stone Edge
text: Stone Edge (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Captivate
text: Captivate (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Stealth Rock
text: Stealth Rock (Rock status move). Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

title: Grass Knot
text: Grass Knot (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120 The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

title: Chatter
text: Chatter (Flying special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion. If the user is not a Chatot, this move will not cause confusion. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.

title: Judgment
text: Judgment (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates. The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type changes depending on the kind of plate held by the user.

title: Bug Bite
text: Bug Bite (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen. The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

title: Charge Beam
text: Charge Beam (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 70%. The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Wood Hammer
text: Wood Hammer (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

title: Aqua Jet
text: Aqua Jet (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

title: Attack Order
text: Attack Order (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Defend Order
text: Defend Order (Bug status move). Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage. The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

title: Heal Order
text: Heal Order (Bug status move). Heals the user for half its max HP. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Head Smash
text: Head Smash (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil. The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.

title: Double Hit
text: Double Hit (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn. The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

title: Roar of Time
text: Roar of Time (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn. The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.

title: Spacial Rend
text: Spacial Rend (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Lunar Dance
text: Lunar Dance (Psychic status move). User faints. Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP and PP restored and its status conditions cured.

title: Crush Grip
text: Crush Grip (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121. The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

title: Magma Storm
text: Magma Storm (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Magma Storm
text: Magma Storm (Fire special move). The user traps the target inside a maelstrom of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

title: Dark Void
text: Dark Void (Dark status move). Puts the target to sleep. Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that puts them to sleep.

title: Seed Flare
text: Seed Flare (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages. Effect chance: 40%. The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also harshly lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Ominous Wind
text: Ominous Wind (Ghost special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage. Effect chance: 10%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Shadow Force
text: Shadow Force (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. The user disappears on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

title: Hone Claws
text: Hone Claws (Dark status move). Raises the user’s Attack and accuracy by one stage. The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

title: Wide Guard
text: Wide Guard (Rock status move). Moves with multiple targets will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

title: Guard Split
text: Guard Split (Psychic status move). Averages the user’s unmodified Defense with the target’s unmodified Defense; the value becomes the unmodified Defense for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Defense is averaged the same way. The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.

title: Power Split
text: Power Split (Psychic status move). Averages the user’s unmodified Attack with the target’s unmodified Attack; the value becomes the unmodified Attack for both Pokémon. Unmodified Special Attack is averaged the same way. This effect applies before any other persistent changes to unmodified Attack or Special Attack, such as Flower Gift during Sunny Day. The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

title: Wonder Room
text: Wonder Room (Psychic status move). For five turns (including this one), every Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped. The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

title: Psyshock
text: Psyshock (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class. The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

title: Venoshock
text: Venoshock (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is poisoned, this move has double power. The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

title: Autotomize
text: Autotomize (Steel status move). Raises the user’s Speed by two stages. Halves the user’s weight; this effect does not stack. The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

title: Rage Powder
text: Rage Powder (Bug status move). Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target. This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

title: Rage Powder
text: Rage Powder (Bug status move). The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.

title: Telekinesis
text: Telekinesis (Psychic status move). For three turns (including this one), moves used against the target have 100% accuracy, but the target is immune to Ground damage. Accuracy of one-hit KO moves is exempt from this effect. This effect is removed by Gravity. If Gravity is already in effect, this move will fail. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Magic Room
text: Magic Room (Psychic status move). For five turns (including this one), passive effects of held items are ignored, and Pokémon will not use their held items. The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

title: Smack Down
text: Smack Down (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage. This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage. If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Smack Down
text: Smack Down (Rock physical move). The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.

title: Storm Throw
text: Storm Throw (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit. The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

title: Flame Burst
text: Flame Burst (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. If this move successfully hits the target, any Pokémon adjacent to the target are damaged for 1/16 their max HP. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Sludge Wave
text: Sludge Wave (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target. Effect chance: 10%. The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.

title: Quiver Dance
text: Quiver Dance (Bug status move). Raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

title: Heavy Slam
text: Heavy Slam (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s

title: Heavy Slam
text: Heavy Slam (Steel physical move). weight | 100 More than 5× the target’s weight | 120 The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

title: Synchronoise
text: Synchronoise (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. Only Pokémon that share a type with the user will take damage from this move. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Electro Ball
text: Electro Ball (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s Speed compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 150. User’s Speed | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s Speed | 60 Up to 3× the target’s Speed | 80 Up to 4× the target’s Speed | 120 More than 4× the target’s

title: Electro Ball
text: Electro Ball (Electric special move). Speed | 150 The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

title: Soak
text: Soak (Water status move). Changes the target to pure Water-type until it leaves the field. If the target has Multitype, this move will fail. The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.

title: Flame Charge
text: Flame Charge (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

title: Coil
text: Coil (Poison status move). Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each. The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

title: Low Sweep
text: Low Sweep (Fighting physical move). Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

title: Acid Spray
text: Acid Spray (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Foul Play
text: Foul Play (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Damage is calculated using the target’s attacking stat rather than the user’s. The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.

title: Simple Beam
text: Simple Beam (Normal status move). Changes the target’s ability to Simple. The user emits a mysterious psychic wave that changes the target's Ability to Simple.

title: Entrainment
text: Entrainment (Normal status move). Changes the target’s ability to match the user’s. This effect ends when the target leaves battle. The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

title: After You
text: After You (Normal status move). The target will act next this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

title: Round
text: Round (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. If Round has already been used this turn, this move’s power is doubled. After this move is used, any other Pokémon using it this turn will immediately do so (in the order they would otherwise act), regardless of Speed or priority. Pokémon using other moves will then continue to act as usual. The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.

title: Echoed Voice
text: Echoed Voice (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. If any friendly Pokémon used this move earlier this turn or on the previous turn, that use’s power is added to this move’s power, to a maximum of 200. The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.

title: Chip Away
text: Chip Away (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Clear Smog
text: Clear Smog (Poison special move). Inflicts regular damage. All of the target’s stat modifiers are reset to zero. The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

title: Stored Power
text: Stored Power (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×. The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

title: Quick Guard
text: Quick Guard (Fighting status move). Moves with priority greater than 0 will not hit friendly Pokémon for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome. The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.

title: Ally Switch
text: Ally Switch (Psychic status move). User switches position on the field with the friendly Pokémon opposite it. If the user is in the middle position in a triple battle, or there are no other friendly Pokémon, this move will fail. The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

title: Scald
text: Scald (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Shell Smash
text: Shell Smash (Normal status move). Raises the user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages each. Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

title: Heal Pulse
text: Heal Pulse (Psychic status move). Heals the target for half its max HP. The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.

title: Hex
text: Hex (Ghost special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power. This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

title: Sky Drop
text: Sky Drop (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act. On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect. If the target is Flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage. Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect. Gust and Twister will additionally have double power. The damage from Hail

title: Sky Drop
text: Sky Drop (Flying physical move). and Sandstorm still applies during this effect. Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. *Bug*: If Gravity is used during a double or triple battle while this move is in effect, this move is not correctly canceled on the target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As this move prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

title: Sky Drop
text: Sky Drop (Flying physical move). This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Shift Gear
text: Shift Gear (Steel status move). Raises the user’s Attack by one stage and its Speed by two stages. The user rotates its gears, boosting its Attack stat and sharply boosting its Speed stat.

title: Circle Throw
text: Circle Throw (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random. If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead. The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

title: Incinerate
text: Incinerate (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, it’s destroyed and cannot be used in response to this move. The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

title: Quash
text: Quash (Dark status move). Forces the target to act last this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority. If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

title: Acrobatics
text: Acrobatics (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the user has no held item, this move has double power. The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

title: Reflect Type
text: Reflect Type (Normal status move). User’s type changes to match the target’s. The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.

title: Retaliate
text: Retaliate (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon fainted on the previous turn, this move has double power. The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.

title: Final Gambit
text: Final Gambit (Fighting special move). Inflicts damage equal to the user’s remaining HP. User faints. The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.

title: Bestow
text: Bestow (Normal status move). Transfers the user’s held item to the target. If the user has no held item, or the target already has a held item, this move will fail. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Inferno
text: Inferno (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

title: Water Pledge
text: Water Pledge (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Grass Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one). A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.

title: Fire Pledge
text: Fire Pledge (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Water Pledge earlier this turn, moves used by any friendly Pokémon have doubled effect chance for four turns (including this one). A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast sea of fire appears.

title: Grass Pledge
text: Grass Pledge (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Fire Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon will take 1/8 their max HP in damage at the end of every turn for four turns (including this one). A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a vast swamp appears.

title: Volt Switch
text: Volt Switch (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

title: Volt Switch
text: Volt Switch (Electric special move). After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

title: Struggle Bug
text: Struggle Bug (Bug special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

title: Bulldoze
text: Bulldoze (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

title: Frost Breath
text: Frost Breath (Ice special move). Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.

title: Dragon Tail
text: Dragon Tail (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon, selected at random. If the target is under the effect of Ingrain or Suction Cups, or it has a Substitute, or its Trainer has no more usable Pokémon, it will not be switched out. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the battle ends instead. The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

title: Work Up
text: Work Up (Normal status move). Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each. The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

title: Electroweb
text: Electroweb (Electric special move). Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

title: Wild Charge
text: Wild Charge (Electric physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil. The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

title: Drill Run
text: Drill Run (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Dual Chop
text: Dual Chop (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn. The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

title: Heart Stamp
text: Heart Stamp (Psychic physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 30%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Horn Leech
text: Horn Leech (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user. The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

title: Sacred Sword
text: Sacred Sword (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion. The user attacks by slicing with a sword. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.

title: Razor Shell
text: Razor Shell (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 50%. The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

title: Heat Crash
text: Heat Crash (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The greater the user’s weight compared to the target’s, the higher power this move has, to a maximum of 120. User’s weight | Power -------------------------------- | ----: Up to 2× the target’s weight | 40 Up to 3× the target’s weight | 60 Up to 4× the target’s weight | 80 Up to 5× the target’s

title: Heat Crash

title: Leaf Tornado
text: Leaf Tornado (Grass special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage. Effect chance: 50%. The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.

title: Steamroller
text: Steamroller (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field. Effect chance: 30%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Cotton Guard
text: Cotton Guard (Grass status move). Raises the user’s Defense by three stages. The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

title: Night Daze
text: Night Daze (Dark special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage. Effect chance: 40%. The user looses a pitch-black shock wave at the target to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

title: Psystrike

This may also confuse the target.

title: Searing Shot

title: Techno Blast
text: Techno Blast (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move’s type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

title: Relic Song

In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.

title: Spirit Shackle
text: Spirit Shackle (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target. The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing.

title: Darkest Lariat
text: Darkest Lariat (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation ignores the target’s stat modifiers, including evasion. The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.

title: Sparkling Aria
text: Sparkling Aria (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target has a burn and takes damage from this move, its burn is healed. The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.

title: Ice Hammer
text: Ice Hammer (Ice physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

title: Floral Healing
text: Floral Healing (Fairy status move). Heals the target for ½ its max HP. If Grassy Terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead. The user restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP. More HP is restored when the ground is Grassy Terrain.

title: High Horsepower
text: High Horsepower (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

title: Strength Sap
text: Strength Sap (Grass status move). Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect. If the target’s Attack is already at -6, this move will fail. In any other situation that would prevent a stat modification, the healing will still succeed. Effect chance: 100%. The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.

title: Solar Blade
text: Solar Blade (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk. The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

title: Leafage
text: Leafage (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

title: Spotlight
text: Spotlight (Normal status move). For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Toxic Thread
text: Toxic Thread (Poison status move). Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

title: Laser Focus
text: Laser Focus (Normal status move). The user’s next move will result in a critical hit. The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

title: Gear Up
text: Gear Up (Steel status move). Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage. The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.

title: Throat Chop
text: Throat Chop (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

title: Pollen Puff
text: Pollen Puff (Bug special move). If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage. If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP. The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

title: Anchor Shot
text: Anchor Shot (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target. The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.

title: Psychic Terrain
text: Psychic Terrain (Psychic status move). Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

title: Psychic Terrain
text: Psychic Terrain (Psychic status move). This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

title: Lunge
text: Lunge (Bug physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

title: Fire Lash
text: Fire Lash (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

title: Power Trip
text: Power Trip (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×. The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

title: Burn Up
text: Burn Up (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation. If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail. To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

title: Speed Swap
text: Speed Swap (Psychic status move). Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target. The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

title: Smart Strike
text: Smart Strike (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

title: Purify
text: Purify (Poison status move). Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP. If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail. The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.

title: Revelation Dance
text: Revelation Dance (Normal special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move’s type matches the user’s first type, if any; otherwise, it’s typeless. The user attacks the target by dancing with all its might. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.

title: Core Enforcer
text: Core Enforcer (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the target has already moved this turn, its ability is nullified. If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.

title: Trop Kick
text: Trop Kick (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

title: Instruct
text: Instruct (Psychic status move). The target immediately uses its most recently-used move. This is independent of the target’s normal action for the turn (i.e., it may end up moving twice), but otherwise functions as usual, including deduction of PP. This effect works for disabled moves and ignores Torment. The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.

title: Beak Blast
text: Beak Blast (Flying physical move). Begins charging at the start of the turn, then attacks as normal. Any Pokémon that makes contact with the user while charging is burned. The charging is not affected by accuracy, sleep, paralysis, or any other effect that would interfere with a move. The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.

title: Clanging Scales
text: Clanging Scales (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

title: Dragon Hammer
text: Dragon Hammer (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

title: Brutal Swing
text: Brutal Swing (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

title: Aurora Veil
text: Aurora Veil (Ice status move). Places the Aurora Veil effect on the user’s side of the field for the next 5 turns. If the weather is not Hail, or the weather is disabled by the effects of Cloud Nine or Air Lock, this move will fail. Any regular damage dealt to an affected Pokémon is reduced by ½. (If there are multiple Pokémon on the affected field, the reduction is ⅓.) This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.

title: Sinister Arrow Raid
text: Sinister Arrow Raid (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Malicious Moonsault
text: Malicious Moonsault (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Oceanic Operetta
text: Oceanic Operetta (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Guardian of Alola
text: Guardian of Alola (Fairy special move). Inflicts direct damage equal to ¾ of the target’s remaining HP. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
text: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Stoked Sparksurfer
text: Stoked Sparksurfer (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Pulverizing Pancake
text: Pulverizing Pancake (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Extreme Evoboost
text: Extreme Evoboost (Normal status move). Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages each. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Genesis Supernova
text: Genesis Supernova (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage, then (if successful) changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Shell Trap
text: Shell Trap (Fire special move). Inflicts regular damage. If the user was not yet hit by an opponent’s physical move this turn, this move will fail. The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.

title: Fleur Cannon
text: Fleur Cannon (Fairy special move). Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages. Effect chance: 100%. The user unleashes a strong beam. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Psychic Fangs
text: Psychic Fangs (Psychic physical move). Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage. The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

title: Stomping Tantrum
text: Stomping Tantrum (Ground physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types. Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

title: Shadow Bone
text: Shadow Bone (Ghost physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 20%. The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

title: Accelerock
text: Accelerock (Rock physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

title: Liquidation
text: Liquidation (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 20%. The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

title: Prismatic Laser
