text: Prismatic Laser (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn. The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

title: Spectral Thief
text: Spectral Thief (Ghost physical move). Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts regular damage. Will not steal stat increases that would put any of the user’s stats at more than +6; any excess is left on the target. Stolen increases are affected by abilities as normal. The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.

title: Sunsteel Strike
text: Sunsteel Strike (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.

title: Moongeist Beam
text: Moongeist Beam (Ghost special move). Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.

title: Tearful Look
text: Tearful Look (Normal status move). Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each. Effect chance: 100%. The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

title: Zing Zap
text: Zing Zap (Electric physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 30%. The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Nature’s Madness
text: Nature’s Madness (Fairy special move). Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP. The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.

title: Multi-Attack
text: Multi-Attack (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates. Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.

title: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
text: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Mind Blown
text: Mind Blown (Fire special move). Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire. The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

title: Plasma Fists
text: Plasma Fists (Electric physical move). After inflicting damage, all Normal-type moves become Electric-type for the remainder of the turn, including status moves. This effect is applied after move type-changing abilities, such as Pixilate and Normalize. The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

title: Photon Geyser
text: Photon Geyser (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

title: Light That Burns the Sky
text: Light That Burns the Sky (Psychic special move). Inflicts damage using either Attack or Special Attack stat, whichever is higher. Determining which stat is used takes into account stat changes but not held items or abilities. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Searing Sunraze Smash
text: Searing Sunraze Smash (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
text: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom (Ghost special move). Inflicts regular damage. Other Pokémon’s abilities cannot activate in response to this move. In particular, it hits through Disguise This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Let’s Snuggle Forever
text: Let’s Snuggle Forever (Fairy physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Splintered Stormshards
text: Splintered Stormshards (Rock physical move). Inflicts damage and removes any terrain present on the battlefield. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Clangorous Soulblaze
text: Clangorous Soulblaze (Dragon special move). Inflicts sound-based damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each. The user’s stats are not raised if the move fails to damage any opposing Pokémon. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Zippy Zap
text: Zippy Zap (Electric physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Splishy Splash
text: Splishy Splash (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. Effect chance: 30%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Floaty Fall
text: Floaty Fall (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Effect chance: 30%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Pika Papow
text: Pika Papow (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Bouncy Bubble
text: Bouncy Bubble (Water special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Buzzy Buzz
text: Buzzy Buzz (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Sizzly Slide
text: Sizzly Slide (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Glitzy Glow
text: Glitzy Glow (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Baddy Bad
text: Baddy Bad (Dark special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Sappy Seed
text: Sappy Seed (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Effect chance: 100%. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Freezy Frost
text: Freezy Frost (Ice special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Sparkly Swirl
text: Sparkly Swirl (Fairy special move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Veevee Volley
text: Veevee Volley (Normal physical move). Inflicts regular damage. This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

title: Double Iron Bash
text: Double Iron Bash (Steel physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn. Effect chance: 30%. The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Max Guard
text: Max Guard (Normal status move). No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by

title: Max Guard
text: Max Guard (Normal status move). this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist

title: Max Guard
text: Max Guard (Normal status move). or Metronome. This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

title: Dynamax Cannon
text: Dynamax Cannon (Dragon special move). This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed. Effect chance: 100%. The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.

title: Snipe Shot
text: Snipe Shot (Water special move). The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target. Effect chance: 100%. The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

title: Jaw Lock
text: Jaw Lock (Dark physical move). Inflicts damage, then prevents you and the target from switching out. The user or target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. If they do, the effect ends. Effect chance: 100%. This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

title: Stuff Cheeks
text: Stuff Cheeks (Normal status move). This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect. Effect chance: 100%. The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

title: No Retreat
text: No Retreat (Fighting status move). Prevents user from switching out. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. The user or target may switch out using, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user already has prevented itself from switching by this effect. Effect chance: 100%. This move boosts all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

title: Tar Shot
text: Tar Shot (Rock status move). Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it. Effect chance: 100%. The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

title: Magic Powder
text: Magic Powder (Psychic status move). Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is Arceus, Silvally, or is already only a Psychic type. Effect chance: 100%. The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.

title: Dragon Darts
text: Dragon Darts (Dragon physical move). Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

title: Teatime
text: Teatime (Normal status move). All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries. This effect is not prevented by Substitute, Embargo, Magic Room, Klutz, or Unnerve. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a berry. Effect chance: 100%. The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

title: Octolock
text: Octolock (Fighting status move). Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field. Effect chance: 100%. The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

title: Bolt Beak
text: Bolt Beak (Electric physical move). Power doubles if the user moves before the target. Effect chance: 100%. The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

title: Fishious Rend
text: Fishious Rend (Water physical move). Power doubles if the user moves before the target. Effect chance: 100%. The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

title: Court Change
text: Court Change (Normal status move). Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa. Effect chance: 100%. With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

title: Max Flare
text: Max Flare (Fire physical move). Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form;

title: Max Flare
text: Max Flare (Fire physical move). every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

title: Max Flutterby
text: Max Flutterby (Bug physical move). If this move hits, lower the Special Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

title: Max Lightning
text: Max Lightning (Electric physical move). For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt. Effect chance: 100%. This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.

title: Max Strike
text: Max Strike (Normal physical move). If this move hits, lower the Speed of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Speed stat.

title: Max Knuckle
text: Max Knuckle (Fighting physical move). If this move hits, raise the Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.

title: Max Phantasm
text: Max Phantasm (Ghost physical move). If this move hits, lower the Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Defense stat.

title: Max Hailstorm
text: Max Hailstorm (Ice physical move). Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Max Hailstorm
text: Max Hailstorm (Ice physical move). This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

title: Max Ooze
text: Max Ooze (Poison physical move). If this move hits, raise the Special Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.

title: Max Geyser
text: Max Geyser (Water physical move). Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon

title: Max Geyser
text: Max Geyser (Water physical move). with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.

title: Max Airstream
text: Max Airstream (Flying physical move). If this move hits, raise the Speed of the user and its allies' by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

title: Max Starfall
text: Max Starfall (Fairy physical move). For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Moonblast. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.

title: Max Wyrmwind
text: Max Wyrmwind (Dragon physical move). If this move hits, lower the Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

title: Max Mindstorm
text: Max Mindstorm (Psychic physical move). Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

title: Max Mindstorm
text: Max Mindstorm (Psychic physical move). Effect chance: 100%. This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.

title: Max Rockfall
text: Max Rockfall (Rock physical move). Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

title: Max Quake
text: Max Quake (Ground physical move). If this move hits, raise the Special Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.

title: Max Darkness
text: Max Darkness (Dark physical move). If this move hits, lower the Special Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

title: Max Overgrowth
text: Max Overgrowth (Grass physical move). For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 their max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Energy Ball. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns.

title: Max Steelspike
text: Max Steelspike (Steel physical move). If this move hits, raise the Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.

title: Clangorous Soul
text: Clangorous Soul (Dragon status move). User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage. Fails if the user would faint, or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed stat cannot go any higher. Effect chance: 100%. The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

title: Body Press
text: Body Press (Fighting physical move). Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

title: Decorate
text: Decorate (Fairy status move). Raise the targets Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. Effect chance: 100%. The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

title: Drum Beating
text: Drum Beating (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

title: Snap Trap
text: Snap Trap (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Snap Trap
text: Snap Trap (Grass physical move). The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

title: Pyro Ball
text: Pyro Ball (Fire physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Effect chance: 10%. The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Behemoth Blade
text: Behemoth Blade (Steel physical move). This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed. Effect chance: 100%. The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

title: Behemoth Bash
text: Behemoth Bash (Steel physical move). This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed. Effect chance: 100%. The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

title: Aura Wheel
text: Aura Wheel (Electric physical move). Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. Fails unless the user is Hangry Mode or Full Belly Mode Morpeko. Effect chance: 100%. Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

title: Breaking Swipe
text: Breaking Swipe (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

title: Branch Poke
text: Branch Poke (Grass physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

title: Overdrive
text: Overdrive (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

title: Apple Acid
text: Apple Acid (Grass special move). Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Grav Apple
text: Grav Apple (Grass physical move). Lower the targets Defense by 1 stage. Damage is increased by 50% during Gravitys effect. Effect chance: 100%. The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

title: Spirit Break
text: Spirit Break (Fairy physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Strange Steam
text: Strange Steam (Fairy special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target. Effect chance: 20%. The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

title: Life Dew
text: Life Dew (Water status move). Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. Effect chance: 100%. The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

title: Obstruct
text: Obstruct (Dark status move). Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn. If this blocks a contact move, the user has their Defense lowered by 2 stages. Effect chance: 100%. This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.

title: False Surrender
text: False Surrender (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. Effect chance: 100%. The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

title: Meteor Assault
text: Meteor Assault (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.

title: Eternabeam
text: Eternabeam (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn. Effect chance: 100%. This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

title: Steel Beam
text: Steel Beam (Steel special move). Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire. Effect chance: 100%. The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

title: Expanding Force
text: Expanding Force (Psychic special move). If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

title: Steel Roller
text: Steel Roller (Steel physical move). Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

title: Scale Shot
text: Scale Shot (Dragon physical move). Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

title: Meteor Beam
text: Meteor Beam (Rock special move). Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn. Effect chance: 100%. The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

title: Shell Side Arm
text: Shell Side Arm (Poison special move). Has a chance to poison the target. This switches categories between physical and special, depending on which would deal more damage to the target. If the damage is tied, it is randomly chosen. This calculation ignores any modifiers other than stat stages. Effect chance: 20%. This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.

title: Misty Explosion
text: Misty Explosion (Fairy special move). If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%. Fails if any active Pokemon has the ability Damp. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is boosted on Misty Terrain.

title: Grassy Glide
text: Grassy Glide (Grass physical move). If Grassy Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its priority increased by 1. Effect chance: 100%. Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

title: Rising Voltage
text: Rising Voltage (Electric special move). If Electric Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has has its power doubled. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.

title: Terrain Pulse
text: Terrain Pulse (Normal special move). If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type. The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

title: Skitter Smack
text: Skitter Smack (Bug physical move). Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Burning Jealousy
text: Burning Jealousy (Fire special move). Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

title: Lash Out
text: Lash Out (Dark physical move). Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn. Effect chance: 100%. The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

title: Poltergeist
text: Poltergeist (Ghost physical move). Fails if the target has no held item. The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

title: Corrosive Gas
text: Corrosive Gas (Poison status move). Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item. Effect chance: 100%. The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

title: Coaching
text: Coaching (Fighting status move). Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user. Effect chance: 100%. The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

title: Flip Turn
text: Flip Turn (Water physical move). Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

title: Flip Turn
text: Flip Turn (Water physical move). Effect chance: 100%. After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

title: Triple Axel
text: Triple Axel (Ice physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses. Skill Link does not apply. Effect chance: 100%. A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

title: Dual Wingbeat
text: Dual Wingbeat (Flying physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn. Effect chance: 100%. The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

title: Scorching Sands
text: Scorching Sands (Ground special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Effect chance: 30%. The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Jungle Healing
text: Jungle Healing (Grass status move). Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up. Effect chance: 100%. The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

title: Wicked Blow
text: Wicked Blow (Dark physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Always scores a critical hit. Effect chance: 100%. The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

title: Surging Strikes
text: Surging Strikes (Water physical move). Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit. Effect chance: 100%. The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

title: Thunder Cage
text: Thunder Cage (Electric special move). Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect. Effect chance: 100%.

title: Thunder Cage
text: Thunder Cage (Electric special move). The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

title: Dragon Energy
text: Dragon Energy (Dragon special move). Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP. Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

title: Freezing Glare
text: Freezing Glare (Psychic special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target. During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect. Effect chance: 10%. The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

title: Fiery Wrath
text: Fiery Wrath (Dark special move). Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch. Effect chance: 20%. The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

title: Thunderous Kick
text: Thunderous Kick (Fighting physical move). Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage. Effect chance: 100%. The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

title: Glacial Lance
text: Glacial Lance (Ice physical move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

title: Astral Barrage
text: Astral Barrage (Ghost special move). Inflicts regular damage. The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

title: Eerie Spell
text: Eerie Spell (Psychic special move). The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used. Effect chance: 100%. The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.

title: Dire Claw
text: Dire Claw (Poison physical move). The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

title: Psyshield Bash
text: Psyshield Bash (Psychic physical move). Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

title: Power Shift
text: Power Shift (Normal status move). The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

title: Stone Axe
text: Stone Axe (Rock physical move). The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

title: Springtide Storm
text: Springtide Storm (Fairy special move). The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

title: Mystical Power
text: Mystical Power (Psychic special move). The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

title: Raging Fury
text: Raging Fury (Fire physical move). The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

title: Wave Crash
text: Wave Crash (Water physical move). The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

title: Chloroblast
text: Chloroblast (Grass special move). The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

title: Mountain Gale
text: Mountain Gale (Ice physical move). The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

title: Victory Dance
text: Victory Dance (Fighting status move). The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

title: Headlong Rush
text: Headlong Rush (Ground physical move). The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

title: Barb Barrage
text: Barb Barrage (Poison physical move). The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

title: Esper Wing
text: Esper Wing (Psychic special move). The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Bitter Malice
text: Bitter Malice (Ghost special move). The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

title: Shelter
text: Shelter (Steel status move). The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

title: Triple Arrows
text: Triple Arrows (Fighting physical move). The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

title: Infernal Parade
text: Infernal Parade (Ghost special move). The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

title: Ceaseless Edge
text: Ceaseless Edge (Dark physical move). The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

title: Bleakwind Storm
text: Bleakwind Storm (Flying special move). The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

title: Wildbolt Storm
text: Wildbolt Storm (Electric special move). The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

title: Sandsear Storm
text: Sandsear Storm (Ground special move). The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

title: Lunar Blessing
text: Lunar Blessing (Psychic status move). The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

title: Take Heart
text: Take Heart (Psychic status move). The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

title: Tera Blast
text: Tera Blast (Normal special move). If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

title: Silk Trap
text: Silk Trap (Bug status move). The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

title: Axe Kick
text: Axe Kick (Fighting physical move). The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

title: Last Respects
text: Last Respects (Ghost physical move). The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

title: Lumina Crash
text: Lumina Crash (Psychic special move). The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

title: Order Up
text: Order Up (Dragon physical move). The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

title: Jet Punch
text: Jet Punch (Water physical move). The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

title: Spicy Extract
text: Spicy Extract (Grass status move). The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

title: Spin Out
text: Spin Out (Steel physical move). The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

title: Population Bomb
text: Population Bomb (Normal physical move). The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

title: Ice Spinner
text: Ice Spinner (Ice physical move). The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

title: Glaive Rush
text: Glaive Rush (Dragon physical move). The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.

title: Revival Blessing
text: Revival Blessing (Normal status move). The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

title: Salt Cure
text: Salt Cure (Rock physical move). The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

title: Triple Dive
text: Triple Dive (Water physical move). The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

title: Mortal Spin
text: Mortal Spin (Poison physical move). The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

title: Doodle
text: Doodle (Normal status move). The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

title: Fillet Away
text: Fillet Away (Normal status move). The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

title: Kowtow Cleave
text: Kowtow Cleave (Dark physical move). The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

title: Flower Trick
text: Flower Trick (Grass physical move). The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

title: Torch Song
text: Torch Song (Fire special move). The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

title: Aqua Step
text: Aqua Step (Water physical move). The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

title: Raging Bull
text: Raging Bull (Normal physical move). The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

title: Make It Rain
text: Make It Rain (Steel special move). The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

title: Psyblade
text: Psyblade (Psychic physical move). The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

title: Hydro Steam
text: Hydro Steam (Water special move). The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

title: Ruination
text: Ruination (Dark special move). The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

title: Collision Course
text: Collision Course (Fighting physical move). The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

title: Electro Drift
text: Electro Drift (Electric special move). The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

title: Shed Tail
text: Shed Tail (Normal status move). The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

title: Chilly Reception
text: Chilly Reception (Ice status move). The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

title: Tidy Up
text: Tidy Up (Normal status move). The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

title: Snowscape
text: Snowscape (Ice status move). The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

title: Pounce
text: Pounce (Bug physical move). The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

title: Trailblaze
text: Trailblaze (Grass physical move). The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

title: Chilling Water
text: Chilling Water (Water special move). The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

title: Hyper Drill
text: Hyper Drill (Normal physical move). The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

title: Twin Beam
text: Twin Beam (Psychic special move). The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

title: Rage Fist
text: Rage Fist (Ghost physical move). The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

title: Armor Cannon
text: Armor Cannon (Fire special move). The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

title: Bitter Blade
text: Bitter Blade (Fire physical move). The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

title: Double Shock
text: Double Shock (Electric physical move). The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

title: Gigaton Hammer
text: Gigaton Hammer (Steel physical move). The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

title: Comeuppance
text: Comeuppance (Dark physical move). The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

title: Aqua Cutter
text: Aqua Cutter (Water physical move). The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Blood Moon
text: Blood Moon (Normal special move). The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

title: Matcha Gotcha
text: Matcha Gotcha (Grass special move). The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

title: Syrup Bomb
text: Syrup Bomb (Grass special move). The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

title: Ivy Cudgel
text: Ivy Cudgel (Grass physical move). The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

title: Electro Shot
text: Electro Shot (Electric special move). The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

title: Tera Starstorm
text: Tera Starstorm (Normal special move). With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

title: Fickle Beam
text: Fickle Beam (Dragon special move). The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

title: Burning Bulwark
text: Burning Bulwark (Fire status move). The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

title: Thunderclap
text: Thunderclap (Electric special move). This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

title: Mighty Cleave
text: Mighty Cleave (Rock physical move). The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

title: Tachyon Cutter
text: Tachyon Cutter (Steel special move). The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

title: Hard Press
text: Hard Press (Steel physical move). The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

title: Dragon Cheer
text: Dragon Cheer (Dragon status move). The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

title: Alluring Voice
text: Alluring Voice (Fairy special move). The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

title: Temper Flare
text: Temper Flare (Fire physical move). Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

title: Supercell Slam
text: Supercell Slam (Electric physical move). The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

title: Psychic Noise
text: Psychic Noise (Psychic special move). The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

title: Upper Hand
text: Upper Hand (Fighting physical move). The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

title: Malignant Chain
text: Malignant Chain (Poison special move). The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

title: Stench
text: Stench (ability). This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect. This ability does not stack with a held item. Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party. By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

title: Drizzle
text: Drizzle (ability). The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

title: Speed Boost
text: Speed Boost (ability). This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn. The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.

title: Battle Armor
text: Battle Armor (ability). Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon. This ability functions identically to Shell Armor. Hard armor protects the Pokémon from critical hits.

title: Sturdy
text: Sturdy (ability). When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP. Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold. If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed. The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

title: Damp
text: Damp (ability). While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect. The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

title: Limber
text: Limber (ability). This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.

title: Sand Veil
text: Sand Veil (ability). During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type. The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm. Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

title: Static
text: Static (ability). Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed. Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable. The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

title: Volt Absorb
text: Volt Absorb (ability). Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves. Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave. If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

title: Water Absorb
text: Water Absorb (ability). Whenever a Water-type move hits this Pokémon, it heals for 1/4 of its maximum HP, negating any other effect on it. Water moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

title: Oblivious
text: Oblivious (ability). This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate. If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared. The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

title: Cloud Nine
text: Cloud Nine (ability). While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock. Eliminates the effects of weather.

title: Compound Eyes
text: Compound Eyes (ability). This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy. This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold). Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively. The Pokémon's compound eyes boost its accuracy.

title: Insomnia
text: Insomnia (ability). This Pokémon cannot be asleep. This causes Rest to fail altogether. If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle. The Pokémon's insomnia prevents it from falling asleep.

title: Color Change
text: Color Change (ability). Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move. If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden. The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes. This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack. In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.

title: Color Change
text: Color Change (ability). The Pokémon’s type becomes the type of the move used on it.

title: Immunity
text: Immunity (ability). This Pokémon cannot be poisoned. This includes bad poison. If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. The Pokémon's immune system prevents it from being poisoned.

title: Flash Fire
text: Flash Fire (ability). This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves. Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle. This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen. The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled. Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute. This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.

title: Flash Fire
text: Flash Fire (ability). If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

title: Shield Dust
text: Shield Dust (ability). This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it. An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate. Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.

title: Own Tempo
text: Own Tempo (ability). This Pokémon cannot be confused. If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed. The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

title: Suction Cups
text: Suction Cups (ability). This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind. Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased. The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.

title: Intimidate
text: Intimidate (ability). When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage. In a double battle, both opponents are affected. This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle. This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.

title: Intimidate
text: Intimidate (ability). When the Pokémon enters a battle, it intimidates opposing Pokémon and makes them cower, lowering their Attack stats.

title: Shadow Tag
text: Shadow Tag (ability). While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.

title: Rough Skin
text: Rough Skin (ability). Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage. This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs. The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

title: Wonder Guard
text: Wonder Guard (ability). This Pokémon is immune to damaging moves that are not super effective against it. Moves that inflict fixed damage, such as Night Shade or Seismic Toss, are considered super effective if their types are. Damage not directly dealt by moves, such as damage from weather, a status ailment, or Spikes, is not prevented. This ability cannot be copied with Role Play or traded away with Skill Swap, but it can be copied with Trace, disabled with Gastro Acid, or changed with Worry Seed. This Pokémon can still use Role Play itself to lose this ability, but not Skill Swap. If this

title: Wonder Guard
text: Wonder Guard (ability). Pokémon has a Substitute, this ability will block moves as usual and any moves not blocked will react to the Substitute as usual. Its mysterious power only lets supereffective moves hit the Pokémon.

title: Levitate
text: Levitate (ability). This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost. By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

title: Effect Spore
text: Effect Spore (ability). Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random. Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected. Contact with the Pokémon may inflict poison, sleep, or paralysis on the attacker.

title: Synchronize
text: Synchronize (ability). Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment. This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned. This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as

title: Synchronize
text: Synchronize (ability). usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries. If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

title: Clear Body
text: Clear Body (ability). This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis. This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap. This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle. Prevents other Pokémon's moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon's stats.

title: Natural Cure
text: Natural Cure (ability). This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon. If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability. The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.

title: Lightning Rod
text: Lightning Rod (ability). All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target. Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it. If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected. When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon. Follow

title: Lightning Rod
text: Lightning Rod (ability). Me takes precedence over this ability. If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost. The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

title: Serene Grace
text: Serene Grace (ability). This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance. An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected. Secret Power is unaffected. Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.

title: Swift Swim
text: Swift Swim (ability). This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

title: Chlorophyll
text: Chlorophyll (ability). This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

title: Illuminate
text: Illuminate (ability). Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled. This ability has no effect in battle. By illuminating its surroundings, the Pokémon prevents its accuracy from being lowered.

title: Trace
text: Trace (ability). When this Pokémon enters battle, it copies a random opponent's ability. This ability cannot copy Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode. When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.

title: Huge Power
text: Huge Power (ability). This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle. This bonus does not count as a stat modifier. This ability functions identically to Pure Power. Doubles the Pokémon's Attack stat.

title: Poison Point
text: Poison Point (ability). Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned. Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

title: Inner Focus
text: Inner Focus (ability). This Pokémon cannot flinch. The Pokémon's intense focus prevents it from flinching or being affected by Intimidate.

title: Magma Armor
text: Magma Armor (ability). This Pokémon cannot be frozen. If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body. The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

title: Water Veil
text: Water Veil (ability). This Pokémon cannot be burned. If a Pokémon is burned and acquires this ability, its burn is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle. The Pokémon's water veil prevents it from being burned.

title: Magnet Pull
text: Magnet Pull (ability). While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out. Pokémon with Run Away can still flee. Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate. Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.

title: Soundproof
text: Soundproof (ability). This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based. Heal Bell is unaffected. Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping. This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used. Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based. Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

title: Rain Dish
text: Rain Dish (ability). This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain. The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

title: Sand Stream
text: Sand Stream (ability). The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition. If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room. Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.

title: Sand Stream
text: Sand Stream (ability). The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.

title: Pressure
text: Pressure (ability). Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP. This ability stacks if multiple targets have it. This ability still affects moves that fail or miss. This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field. If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP. When this Pokémon enters battle,

title: Pressure
text: Pressure (ability). all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased. Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.

title: Thick Fat
text: Thick Fat (ability). This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire- and Ice-type moves. The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

title: Early Bird
text: Early Bird (ability). This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1. If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up. The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

title: Flame Body
text: Flame Body (ability). Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned. Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly. This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor. Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

title: Run Away
text: Run Away (ability). This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability. Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

title: Keen Eye
text: Keen Eye (ability). This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered. This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate. This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap. Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped. The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.

title: Hyper Cutter
text: Hyper Cutter (ability). This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon. This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn. This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap. The Pokémon's prized, mighty pincers prevent other Pokémon from lowering its Attack stat.

title: Pickup
text: Pickup (ability). At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one. After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one. The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up. The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level. This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.

title: Pickup
text: Pickup (ability). The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

title: Truant
text: Truant (ability). Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around"). Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do. Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around. Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used. Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure,

title: Truant
text: Truant (ability). such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual. If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending. If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn. If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt;

title: Truant
text: Truant (ability). that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did. This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap. Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.

title: Hustle
text: Hustle (ability). This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy. Special moves are unaffected. Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased. Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but lowers its accuracy.

title: Cute Charm
text: Cute Charm (ability). Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated.
